decisions.statement: Only an account with weekly allowance left to spend is counted.
The reading is the soonest window still ahead of the moment asked in.
A window already behind that moment is left out rather than read as zero.
No account with a window ahead is no reading rather than a wait of zero.
The color this reading takes is the color the weekly usage reading is shown in.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.

definition: how long until the weekly allowance window closes
